title: Google Forms AI agent for every new response | 50agents
description: Tell Captain the job and a Google Forms AI agent does it: replies to each response, logs it to Sheets, routes requests for approval, flags bad ratings.
h1: A Google Forms AI agent that handles every response for you
answer: With 50agents, a Google Forms AI agent picks up each new response, replies to the person, logs it to a sheet, tells your team in Slack and starts the next step in apps like HubSpot, Google Calendar and Trello, across the 2,300+ apps you already use.
You describe the job to Captain in one sentence, check the plan it shows, and it runs on its own whenever someone submits your form. It can also build the form and add questions for you.
asks: When someone fills my enquiry form, email them a friendly reply the same hour and add them to HubSpot
Every Monday, read last week's responses to my feedback form and send me a short summary of what people said
When someone submits the leave form, ask their manager in Slack with Approve and Decline buttons
Create a Google Form for event sign-ups with name, email, phone and meal choice

faqs.q: What can a Google Forms AI agent actually do?
faqs.a: It starts when “New Form Response” fires, then reads the answers, writes a reply, adds a row or contact, or asks someone to approve. It can also read past responses with “List Form Responses” and build forms with “Create Google Form”.

faqs.q: Does the form need to be changed to connect it?
faqs.a: No. You pick the form you already use, and Captain reads each new response from it. You do not add scripts or add-ons to the form.

faqs.q: Does a new response start the work at once?
faqs.a: “New Form Response” is checked on a schedule, so the work starts shortly after someone submits rather than the same second. For an enquiry or a leave request, that gap is normally fine.

faqs.q: Can it reply to the person who filled the form?
faqs.a: Yes, if the form asks for an email address. The AI agent reads their answers, writes the reply and sends it from your Gmail. Until you allow it to send on its own, it asks you first.

faqs.q: Can it send form responses to Google Sheets?
faqs.a: Yes. Each “New Form Response” can be added as a row in the sheet you pick, with the answers in the right columns, and the AI agent can add columns such as a topic tag or a short summary.

faqs.q: Can it get a manager's approval from a form request?
faqs.a: Yes. A leave, expense or purchase form can start a Slack message with Approve and Decline buttons, and the next step waits for the answer. Nothing else happens until someone taps.

faqs.q: Can it summarise all my responses?
faqs.a: Yes. “List Form Responses” reads every response to a form, so Captain can write a weekly summary, count answers or pick out common complaints and send them to you.

faqs.q: Can it create or edit a Google Form for me?
faqs.a: Yes. “Create Google Form” makes a new form from your description, “Get Form Details” reads what a form asks today, and “Add Questions to Form” adds questions with the type and options you want.
